newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Shell's Wavin sees slightly higher profits.
newsitem.headline: Shell's Wavin sees slightly higher profits.

text.p: Plastics maker Wavin BV said on Wednesday it expected 1997 profits to be slightly higher than 1996's 37 million guilders.
The company said it did not expect sales to show an improvement and said margins were expected to remain under pressure in 1997.
"Therefore, further measures will be taken to cut costs and improve productivity to result in a slightly higher net profit in 1997," Wavin said in a statement.
The company said the forecast was based on the condition that raw material prices would not change extremely.
Wavin said each of its core activities had clearly improved its prospects in 1996.
The company, a 50 percent owned unit of Royal Dutch/Shell, earlier posted 1996 net profit of 37 million guilders, up from 21 million in the previous year.
